ammonia.reason: pH 4.6-soluble N only ~0.25% at 14d with no amino-acid deamination, so NH3 negligible.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk with no smear bacteria, so p-cresol/indole/skatole not produced.

bitter.reason: Short 7-14d ripening limits accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation or piercing, so C7-C11 methyl ketones absent.

browning.reason: Residual lactose 0.6-1.3% and galactose allows mild Maillard on heating but high moisture limits color.

buttery.reason: S. thermophilus citrate metabolism yields moderate diacetyl/acetoin in high-moisture lactic curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Total lipolysis only ~400-550 mg FFA/kg as butyric acid at 14d, so butyric sweaty note minimal.

creaminess.reason: 56% fat-in-dry-matter with ~60-63% moisture gives lubricating creamy matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Young hydrated calcium-paracasein network deforms rather than fractures, no granular crumb.

firmness.reason: 63% moisture weak rennet gel with minimal syneresis gives very soft spoonable body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in young curd.

fruity.reason: Very short age and low esterase activity, so ethyl butanoate/hexanoate not formed.

goaty.reason: Cow milk with C8:0 <6 ppm and minimal short-chain FFA, so caprylic goaty note absent.

malty_nutty.reason: No extended ripening or propionibacteria, so Strecker aldehydes and nutty notes negligible.

melt.reason: High moisture, pH 5.15-5.35 demineralized casein flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface Geotrichum/Penicillium, so 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one pathway absent.

oil_off.reason: Young intact fat emulsion with low free oil; slight oiling only on thorough melting.

smoky.reason: Not smoked with no wood pyrolysis, so guaiacol/phenols absent.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid ~0.7% plus acetic acid ~0.5 g/kg from starter gives mild vinegar-sour at pH 5.3.

stretch.reason: Not stretched in hot water with no aligned paracasein fibers, so fibrous stretch absent.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurized milk without high cook and no methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMS.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose 0.6-1.3% plus galactose ~0.9% retained gives milky sweet.

umami.reason: Very limited proteolysis to free glutamate by rennet and starter peptidases at 14d.
